plugin.note: Mogres have Defence level 48 but all defensive bonuses 0, so any melee weapon works. Each Mogre is lured out of the sand at Mudskipper Point with a fishing explosive. A minor 20% earth weakness makes earth spells a Magic alternative.

requirements: 32 Slayer, combat level 30, and completion of Skippy and the Mogres are required to fight and be assigned Mogres.
Fishing explosives are used on the mud patches at Mudskipper Point to lure Mogres out.
Food is recommended, as Mogres can hit up to 8.
mechanics: Mogres are lured out of the sand at Mudskipper Point using a fishing explosive.
Mogres have Defence level 48 with all defensive bonuses 0, so weapon choice is unimportant.
Mogres have a 20% elemental weakness to earth spells.
Mogres are not undead, so the salve amulet does not apply.

methods.label: Melee after luring
methods.summary: Lure each Mogre out with a fishing explosive, then kill it with any melee weapon.
steps: Complete Skippy and the Mogres and travel to Mudskipper Point.
Use a fishing explosive on a mud patch to lure a Mogre out of the sand.
Kill the Mogre with any melee weapon; its zero defensive bonuses make weapon choice unimportant.
notes: Keep a stock of fishing explosives, as each lure consumes one.

methods.label: Earth spells
methods.summary: Earth spells exploit the minor 20% earth weakness for a Magic alternative once a Mogre is lured.
steps: Lure a Mogre out with a fishing explosive.
Cast earth spells to exploit the 20% elemental weakness.
notes: The earth weakness is small (20%); melee is usually faster.
